description: This source file defines Express HTTP GET routes that serve mock data for various analytics and dashboard components related to usage metrics, feature adoption, costs, effectiveness, license utilization, support trends, team adoption, feature usage by team, and workflow dropoff. The routes produce JSON responses with synthetic data, primarily for testing or prototyping purposes. Extensive Swagger annotations document each endpoint.

methods.name: GET /api/mockTimeSeries
methods.description: Serves mock time series data for usage metrics like DAU, WAU, MAU over the last 30 days.

methods.name: GET /api/mockModuleUsage
methods.description: Provides mock data about module usage counts and average session durations for core modules.

methods.name: GET /api/mockFeatureAdoptionFunnel
methods.description: Returns mock funnel data representing feature discovery and adoption stages.

methods.name: GET /api/mockCostByUser
methods.description: Provides mock per-user cost, credits used, and remaining data.

methods.name: GET /api/mockFeatureUsageByUser
methods.description: Returns mock user-feature usage counts and durations for heatmaps and rankings.

methods.name: GET /api/mockUserProductivity
methods.description: Serves mock user productivity metrics such as task completion, acceptance ratios, and time saved.

methods.name: GET /api/mockEffectiveness
methods.description: Provides mock effectiveness metrics for AI outputs including accepted, edited, discarded counts, and trend over time.

methods.name: GET /api/mockLicenseUtilization
methods.description: Serves mock license utilization data including active seats, purchased seats, and daily active seat trends.

methods.name: GET /api/mockSupportTrends
methods.description: Returns mock support ticket volume and resolution time series data.

methods.name: GET /api/mockTeamAdoptionSummary
methods.description: Provides mock ranked data of teams by active users and usage intensity.

methods.name: GET /api/mockFeatureUsageByTeam
methods.description: Returns mock feature usage segmented by team for stacked bar charts.

methods.name: GET /api/mockWorkflowDropoff
methods.description: Returns mock funnel stages with completion and abandonment counts for workflow analysis.
